title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Row, Row, Row Your Boat with Lulu the little duck! Lulu rows down a sunny stream, fish jump on every "merrily", and a frog and a bird join the boat before bedtime.

A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1852) for children aged 2 to 6.
